summary.text: Tim Johnson, listed by Ballotpedia as Timothy Johnson, is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 38 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A former teacher and public safety director, he serves as vice chair of the Child Welfare and Foster Care Committee.

paragraphs.text: Johnson earned a bachelor's degree in education from Bethany College in 1975, a master's degree in administration of justice from Wichita State University in 1982, and a master's degree in education from Pittsburg State University in 2005.

His career experience includes working as a teacher at Basehor-Linwood High School and Wyandotte High School, as a special investigator with the State of Kansas, and as director of public safety for the city of Lindsborg, Kansas.
Johnson took office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Representative Willie Dove.

During the 2025-2026 session he served on the K-12 Education Budget, Veterans and Military, and Child Welfare System Oversight committees, and as vice chair of the Child Welfare and Foster Care Committee.
